data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The Collatz conjecture remains unsettled because it lacks a causal mechanism explaining the global attraction to the 4-2-1 cycle across all natural numbers.","counterconditions":[{"case":"Discovery of a counter-example (a number that diverges to infinity).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Discovery of a non-trivial cycle (a loop other than 4-2-1).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The conjecture is likely true due to a stochastic drift where the average growth (3n+1) is outweighed by the geometric decay of division by 2 (since (3n+1)/2^k on average trends downward), but a formal proof requires showing that no 'divergent' trajectory or 'isolated cycle' can emerge from the parity-driven dynamics.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
